tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This document will be updated once a decision is made and recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

The project's memory has no compression record. The catalog lists only these decisions:
- https everywhere
- verification on all builds
- rustls
- argon2id
- an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL

A `muninn why` query on the compression codec came back "insufficient". The earlier-session excerpts it returned cover serialization (msgpack, then cbor), the async runtime, TLS, caching and licensing, and none of them mention compression.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.
